title: Art direction registry
purpose: Pick a look from a registry of named styles, each with its tokens, palette, shape, line, material and light, its consistency risk, its fit with camera and motion, its cost, its legal terms and when not to use it. Styles are described by their visual traits, never by the name of a living artist or a studio.
use_cases: Choosing the series look at G0 and recording it as `look.style` in filmspec, with the tokens reused in every sheet and keyframe prompt.
Checking whether a look survives the shot list: long camera moves, fast action, many characters.
Mixing looks on purpose (a flashback in ink wash) and recording that as a scene-level exception.
Estimating the cost of a look before G0: some need more retakes or GL work to stay consistent.
anti_patterns: Naming a living artist or a studio in a prompt to borrow their style.
A look chosen from one beautiful still that breaks down in motion (texture boiling, line flicker).
Palette drift: each sheet and keyframe invents its own colours instead of reusing the tokens.
Mixing looks shot to shot with no story reason.
Choosing a high-detail look for an action-heavy episode on a small budget.

registry.tokens: flat cel shading, clean ink lines, two-tone shadows
registry.shape_line_material_light: clear silhouettes; uniform line weight; materials by colour, not texture; hard-edged light
registry.camera_motion_fit: pans, trucks and fast action; orbits and rotating 3D moves are its weak spot
registry.avoid_when: the story needs painterly texture or photographic depth

registry.tokens: 1980s-90s TV anime, film grain, soft halation, painted backgrounds
registry.shape_line_material_light: thicker lines, airbrushed highlights, painted skies; bloom on lights
registry.consistency_risk: medium (grain and halation must match in grade)
registry.avoid_when: a modern, crisp product feel is required

registry.tokens: ink wash, brush strokes, wet edges, paper texture
registry.palette: monochrome ink with one accent colour
registry.shape_line_material_light: shape by brush; variable line; negative space; light by absence of ink
registry.cost: more retakes; GL paper overlay helps

registry.tokens: watercolour washes, soft edges, granulation, paper white
registry.shape_line_material_light: soft shapes; little line; light from paper white
registry.avoid_when: fast cutting, dark scenes or heavy contrast

registry.tokens: opaque gouache, matte flat colour, visible brush texture
registry.shape_line_material_light: bold shapes; few lines; flat light planes
registry.camera_motion_fit: most moves; texture should ride the plate
registry.avoid_when: glossy or metallic materials carry the story

registry.tokens: high-contrast black and white, heavy shadow shapes, halftone
registry.shape_line_material_light: shadow as shape; hard key light; strong silhouettes
registry.camera_motion_fit: static and dutch angles; slow push

registry.shape_line_material_light: 3D volumes with 2-3 shading steps; outlines from geometry
registry.cost: high setup (models, rigs), low per shot
registry.avoid_when: no 3D pipeline or a hand-drawn feel is essential

registry.tokens: cut paper, collage, photo texture over drawn characters
registry.shape_line_material_light: layers with visible edges; light baked per element
registry.camera_motion_fit: lateral moves; flat cel moves (no layer-split parallax)
registry.legal: every photo or texture needs a licence
registry.avoid_when: sources cannot be licensed or the shot list is long

checks.measure: reviewer compares a contact sheet of one frame per scene against the look tokens
checks.pass: no scene drifts off-palette without a recorded exception

checks.measure: reviewer searches sheet and keyframe prompts for artist or studio names
the user approves the look at G0/G1
